messages:
alex_k: Quick async check-in for SDKs + sample apps — TL;DR what I did / blockers / today

alex_k: Yesterday: finished python SDK auth header switch and pushed draft docs. Blocker: sample-app CI fails on mac runners (M1 buildx). Today: ship release notes and finish tagging PRs.

maya: Done: updated quickstart snippets to use the new Authorization header pattern, and replaced an old example token in the docs (sanity-checked). Blocker: mac wheels failing in CI (pip wheel step), looks like a packaging flag.

chris: Fixed sample-app Dockerfile (COPY path typo) and pushed a small patch — build green on my linux runner. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/218

alex_k: Reviewed chris's change, left two tiny nits about comments. Main blocker is still the M1 build. @jing can you take a look at the buildx flags or suggest a CI workaround?

jing: Yup — I think adding --platform=linux/amd64 to docker build will avoid the arm artifact issue. I'll open a tiny PR that sets that flag in the CI step and also add an optional matrix for arm to test later. Will try to repro locally on my M1 later today.

samuel: Docs note: I added a short caveat in the quickstarts about quantization caveats (small prompt contexts can degrade perf). Need a quick sanity check on wording. /cc @maya

maya: I'll take the wording after lunch. Also spotted that the embedding example still uses the old param name `model_id` — updating that to `model` across snippets.

devex-bot: CI / docs-deploy: build passed for branch 'docs/sample-fixes' (job 4213) — docs staging deploy queued :rocket:

alex_k: Follow-up: found flaky test in sample-app integration (env var not set in mac CI). Added a tiny wrapper script to set defaults; will push after Jing's buildx patch merges. Today: finalize release notes and tag the python SDK.

chris: Note for testers: to run sample-app locally try `make run-local` with `ENV=LOCAL` and `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` — logs are under ./logs/*. If you hit a permission error on mac, try `chmod +x scripts/*`.

maya: :thumbsup: linking checklist for release QA and docs: https://confluence.redwood.com/spaces/DEVEX/pages/6789/sample-app-release-checklist

alex_k: If anyone has bandwidth today — can you give a quick review of the release notes draft? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — just looking for clarity + any missing migration notes. Thanks!
